meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 它读完全部 open issue 的正文和评论，按同一个根因把它们归成几个 plan-master 主计划 issue，每个主计划配一份 plans/0X-*.md 设计文档；子 issue 用统一评论重定向后关闭，再用一个 PR 一次性关掉整簇。
howto.when: 当仓库积累了几十个同源重复 issue，或你要求 triage／consolidate／cluster／dedupe、从 open issue 建 roadmap 时接管；新报的 bug 也会被判断归入哪个已有计划。

say.text: 把这堆 open issue 按根因归成几个 plan-master
say.note: 读全文后开主计划 issue，并关闭子 issue

say.text: 这个新报的 bug 归到哪个已有计划？
say.note: 匹配上就在主计划下发 Round N 评论并关掉它

say.text: 把这个 plan 的子 issue 合成一个 PR
say.note: PR 里用 Closes #N 自动关闭整簇

howto.what_en: It reads every open issue's body and comments, clusters them by shared root cause into a few plan-master issues, mirrors each as a plans/0X-*.md doc, then closes children with a redirect comment; one PR closes a whole cluster.
howto.when_en: Use when a tracker holds dozens of same-root-cause issues, when asked to triage/consolidate/cluster/dedupe or build a roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new bug into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Cluster these open issues into plan masters by root cause
say_en.note: Reads full text, opens masters, closes children

say_en.text: Which existing plan does this new bug belong to?
say_en.note: Posts a Round N comment on the master and closes it

say_en.text: Turn this plan's children into one PR
say_en.note: PR uses Closes #N to auto-close the whole cluster
